title: A COMPLETELY Upgradeable Laptop?  - Framework Laptop Review
summary: Linus Tech Tips reviews the first Framework Laptop, a fully repairable and upgradeable machine. The reviewer expected a flimsy chunky device and was happily surprised.
why: Many HN commenters say this review convinced them to consider Framework as an alternative to Apple and Lenovo laptops.

quote.text: I saw the review made by Linus : - totally got me convinced.
